featured_reviews.name: Shivani Gavande
featured_reviews.review_text:
During this lockdown I was craving for some delicious rolls so I happened to order from this place. Rolls Mania have a few outlets which serves a range of quick bites and snacks. It serves the best quality and delicious rolls. They even serve fries, nachos, cheese poppers and more as sides. They also have a variety of rolls in both veg, non veg and egg. Also they serve some refreshing drinks , cold coffee and frappes.

What I ordered?
1) Cheese Chilli Manchurian Roll - The roll had a delicious combination of indo - chinese flavours. It had a delicious stuffing of manchurian chunks filled with cheese ,veggies and potato. The taste of the roll was spicy and tangy sort of which was tempting for all the spicy lovers. It had a good quantity and too much filling. Overall it was a best roll for the vegetarians.

2) Butter chicken Fries - I found these Butter chicken fries something unique and amazing. I loved these fries were the yummiest i ever tried.   It had a perfect blend of sweet and spicy taste of the thick gravy. The fries were nice and crispy with a combination of juicy butter chicken gravy tasted really fantastic. Must try these its the bestseller fries over here. Good filling and quantity.

3) Cheese Fries - The classic fries were crispy and loaded with lots of messy cheese. Yummy and simple cheesy fries for all the cheese lovers.

4) Nachos - The nachos were crispy, crunchier and classic in taste. It came with a mayo dip. I had a great time munching these crunchier nachos which had a sort of mexican flavours.

Everything came with a neat packaging and proper hygiene and sanitization practices were taken care of which I loved. So I definitely recommend you all to order from this place for good quality and delicious rolls.

Food - 4/5

featured_reviews.name: Manish Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being a meat lover, I was searching for a place to have good mutton options in a sea of veg restaurants in Goregaon East, when I found Rogan Tadka.

I had tried non veg food from local restaurants in these first few days in Mumbai and I was less than satisfied. So I just ordered Mutton Sheekh Kabab, which l knew would give me a fair idea of how they cook their mutton and balance their spices. And in case it doesn't suit my palate, I wont have much to waste.

I was pleasantly surprised when the Sheekh Kabab tasted just as it should, with the right balance of spices, without going overboard with it and retaining the original essence and taste of mutton which is the primary ingredient. Served with green pudina chatni, it only enhanced the taste.

The staff was friendly and helpful and the service was timely, as much as it should reasonably take to serve a good plate of sheekh kebabs.

The ambience is average and the prices are also reasonable, maybe slightly on the higher side but I got value for money, so it seemed fair to me. They had steel chairs with no leather seats - they can improve on that.

In the evenings, it is better to go after 7:30 pm.
